founder.title: Guidance from Someone Who Has Done It
paragraphs: I moved to Malta with around two years of IT experience and built my career here step by step, progressing into a Senior Site Reliability Engineer role.
Along the way, I experienced job applications, interviews, company changes, salary negotiations, work permit processes and the realities of building a life in Malta.
Malta Mentor is the practical resource I wish I had before moving: honest guidance, realistic expectations and clear next steps for IT professionals considering Malta.
credibility: Experience across multiple IT roles and companies
Practical understanding of Malta’s working and living conditions

about.title: About
about.introShort: Senior SRE in Malta, guiding international IT professionals through realistic career and relocation decisions.
story: I moved to Malta with around two years of IT experience and built my career here step by step, progressing into a Senior Site Reliability Engineer role.

Over that time I have worked in different sectors and roles—from startups to more established companies. That variety gave me exposure to how teams hire, how interviews are structured, and what employers in Malta actually look for beyond buzzwords on a CV.

I mentor IT professionals who want to find a job here or take the next step in their career. My aim is to share what I have learned first-hand: how to present your experience clearly, prepare for technical and behavioural interviews, and understand the local job market with realistic expectations.
If you are planning to relocate or are already on the island and want structured guidance, I would be glad to help you move forward with clarity and confidence.

careerFit.title: Malta Career Fit
careerFit.subtitle: Answer 7 short questions and get an instant readiness indicator for exploring IT opportunities in Malta.
careerFit.intro: This is an educational self-assessment—not a hiring, immigration or legal decision. Take about two minutes to see where you stand.
careerFit.note: Free assessment. No job or visa guarantees.

experience.title: How many years of professional IT experience do you have?

field.title: Which area best describes your current profession?

options.product: Product / Project / Business Analysis in technology
options.entry: Entry-level or currently transitioning into IT

english.title: How comfortable are you working and interviewing in English?

options.notComfortable: I am not yet comfortable communicating professionally
options.basic: I can manage basic workplace conversations
options.someDifficulty: I can work and interview in English with some difficulty
options.comfortable: I am comfortable working and interviewing in English
options.fluent: I am fully fluent or use English professionally every day

cv.title: How prepared are your CV and LinkedIn profile for international applications?

options.notPrepared: I have not prepared them yet
options.majorImprovement: They exist but need major improvement
options.notTailored: They are updated but not tailored to Malta or international roles
options.wellStructured: They are well structured and focused on measurable experience
options.activelyTailored: They are actively tailored to relevant roles

workAuth.title: Which option best describes your current situation?
workAuth.infoNote: This question only reflects the practical complexity of the process. Malta Mentor does not provide legal or immigration advice.

options.rightToWork: I already have the right to work in Malta
options.sponsorship: I am a non-EU professional who may require employer sponsorship
options.unsure: I am not sure what type of permission I would need

salary.title: How have you formed your salary expectations for Malta?

options.notResearched: I have not researched salaries or living costs yet
options.targetOnly: I have a salary target but have not compared it with Malta’s market
options.salaryOnly: I have researched salaries but not calculated my likely living costs
options.compared: I have compared salaries, taxes and living costs
options.realistic: I understand that expectations may need to vary by role, experience and relocation conditions

relocation.title: How prepared are you to relocate if you receive a suitable opportunity?

options.withinYear: I may consider relocating within the next year
options.3to6months: I would consider relocating within 3–6 months
options.1to3months: I am actively applying and could relocate within 1–3 months

early.title: Early Exploration

developing.explanation: Your profile shows some potential for Malta’s IT market, but stronger preparation could significantly improve your positioning. Your next priority should be addressing the weaker areas identified in this assessment.

good.title: Good Foundation
good.explanation: You have a solid starting point for exploring Malta-based IT opportunities. Your profile appears reasonably prepared, but targeted improvements in your application strategy or relocation planning may increase your chances of making better career decisions.

insights.nextStepSalary: Compare role-specific salaries with realistic living-cost scenarios for Malta.
insights.nextStepApply: Validate your assumptions with targeted applications and employer research.
insights.nextStepStrategy: Consider a structured job-search plan to turn your preparation into focused action.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Malta Mentor collects information you submit through contact forms, newsletter sign-ups and career fit requests in order to respond to enquiries and provide guidance services.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: This may include your name, email address, message content and package preferences. Technical logs may be stored for security and debugging purposes.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use submitted information to reply to your requests, deliver mentorship services you book, and—if you opt in—send relevant updates about Malta Mentor resources.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.
